name: Market 001 — ürün listesi açılır ve varyant ürün görünmez
description: Demo Market (001) oturumunda yönetim ürün listesinde ürünler listelenir; TSHIRT-VAR / PHONE-VAR veya varyant satırları görünmemelidir.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the RetailEX login page
Connect tenant retailex_demo if needed, then sign in as admin / admin
Select firm Demo Market (001), pick a store if needed, and enter the app
Open the Management / Yönetim module from the top shell
Navigate to the products / ürünler list screen
Verify a product list table or grid is visible with at least one product row, and no product named TSHIRT-VAR or PHONE-VAR and no variant-matrix indicator for clothing variants appears in the list
